Time: release and authorization must still be valid now
Continuity: artifact lineage must connect to the recorded source commit
Alignment: artifact purpose must match authorized defensive deployment
Genesis: source commit and release receipt identify origin
Boundary: deployment is limited to explicitly authorized systems
Reference: the exact artifact digest must match the approved receipt
Causality: allow or deny must be attributable to the verified gate decision
Consciousness: an independent observer can reproduce and verify the receipt
